positions.as_written: Assess the meniscus itself first, since the parent tear is usually a horizontal or oblique split.
Compare the meniscal height across the slices, since a leaf lifted away makes the parent thinner.
Assess both the coronal and sagittal images, because a leaf is often visible in only one.
